name: chrome-extension-google-meet-enhancements
description: Chrome extension: small fixes for Google Meet, like muting the sound of one meeting window without touching the others, and starting every meeting with your camera and mic off.

scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../extension.zip . -x '.*'
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run knip && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
